rationale: IMPORTED-BINDING CLAIM for STATIC single-member imports (Lead claim kind, live 2026-10-19). The analyzer publishes the EVIDENCE on the import edge (metadata.importedBindings + metadata.module, the gate's importsByFile key/specifier) and the CLAIM on the target row (metadata.importedBinding {specifier, binding}) for EXTERNAL containers only (JVM roots + java-platform-libraries roots). Positive: `import static java.util.Collections.sort;` + unqualified `sort(xs)`. Negatives: a project static import (`com.acme.own.ProjectUtil.projectHelper` — container not external, so no evidence and no claim), a name the FILE declares (declaration shadows the import), and a RECEIVER-CARRYING call. POSITIVE CLAIM PINS: the Lead's fixture matcher now compares non-array object metadata by stable key-sorted recursive JSON, so the claim object itself is pinned for BOTH external containers (`java.util.Collections.sort` and `jakarta.persistence.Persistence.createEntityManagerFactory`); the negatives assert the ABSENCE (`meta.importedBinding: null`). The arbiter's arm verification (bindOK with bindFAIL 0) remains the authoritative end-to-end check. POST-2026-11-16 EVIDENCE RULE: jakarta is project-ownable. Without a complete project index the analyzer cannot assert the imported container is external, so the jakarta import and call are still present but carry no EXTERNAL imported-binding claim; JVM java.util imports retain their bound evidence.

forbidRelationships.comment: a project static import is project code: it must not publish external-import evidence
the file declares asList, which shadows the static import: no claim may be attached
